subject: Hosted IO unit rates + supported model roster
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@novum.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novum AI Procurement <procurement@novum.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask: per-1M token IO split + supported models for hosted API

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. We're evaluating hosted inference vendors for a small pilot and need a quick baseline to compare unit economics across providers. Two asks:

1) Can you share standard per-1M token rates split by input vs output (hosted API)? If you have a short table for "base" and "large" model classes that helps.
2) A short list of the models you currently support on the hosted tier (anything Redwood-verified or recommended for production).

For context: our pilot allocates ~2M tokens/month but if things go well we'll be looking at commit options in the 10-30M/month range next quarter. Latency SLO is <350ms p95 for typical chat workloads. We also care about streaming support and whether quantized variants are available for cost optimization.

I've attached a quick usage projection (Novum_usage_projection_Q4.csv) — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that's easier.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Platform
Novum AI

Attachment: Novum_usage_projection_Q4.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@novum.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token IO split + supported models for hosted API

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and the projection. Looping in Marissa and Ben (pricing & solutions) so they have visibility. Quick baseline below; attaching our standard ratecard and a short model roster for hosted.

Baseline hosted IO rates (per 1M tokens):
- Base family (cost-optimized): input $6.00 / 1M, output $9.00 / 1M
- Standard family (balanced perf/cost): input $10.00 / 1M, output $15.00 / 1M
- High-fidelity family (largest context / best quality): input $22.00 / 1M, output $33.00 / 1M

Notes:
- Rates above are for hosted API (no commit). We offer committed discounts starting at 10M/month (see proposal ranges).
- Quantized variants (4-bit) are available for many base/standard models and can reduce token cost by ~25–40% depending on the workload. We can route traffic to quantized variants automatically if you opt in.
- Streaming and chunked responses are supported; p95 latency is workload-dependent but our standard hosted SLAs are designed for sub-350ms on Standard family for typical chat shapes.

Supported model list (hosted catalog, short):
- redwood-base-v1 (cost-optimized, quant-ready)
- redwood-standard-v2 (recommended for production chat)
- redwood-hf-extended-v1 (long context, high quality)
- open-compat/gptx-compat (community-backed; recommended for specific benchmarks)

I've attached: redwood-ratecard-v2.pdf (summary) and a short model-compatibility spreadsheet. If you want a quick committed quote for 2M / 10M / 25M steps, I can produce a clean one-pager.

Next step: would a 20-min sync on Friday morning work to go over latency SLOs and traffic shape?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-ratecard-v2.pdf (PDF, 78KB)

- Can you confirm whether the quoted IO rates include both input and output token accounting for streamed responses (i.e., tokens emitted as they stream are billable as output)?

Subject: Re: Quick ask: per-1M token IO split + supported models for hosted API

Alex — thanks for the questions and for confirming the call. Quick answers and a ballpark committed quote below; attaching a concise proposal and a draft SOW.

Answers:
- Streaming: streamed tokens are billed as output tokens at the same output rate; input tokens are billed when the request is received.
- Quantized variants: available on hosted for most Base and Standard-family models (we maintain quantized artifacts for the hosted fleet). Dedicated/private gives you more control and custom quantization options.

Committed ballparks (Standard family, effective per-1M after discount):
- 2M/month (no commit): input $10.00 / 1M, output $15.00 / 1M (list)
- 10M/month commit: 10% discount -> input $9.00 / 1M, output $13.50 / 1M
- 25M/month commit: 15% discount -> input $8.50 / 1M, output $12.75 / 1M
- 50M+ custom pricing (reach out — we do tiered schedules and SLA bundling)

Example total: for your 2M pilot (assume 40% input / 60% output): approx monthly charge = (0.4*2M/1M*$10) + (0.6*2M/1M*$15) = $8 + $18 = $26 (per month) — note: that example is illustrative; line items on the proposal include model selection and streaming overhead.

Next steps: I've attached redwood-proposal-novum-20260907.pdf and SOW_draft.docx. If you want me to convert this to a formal procurement quote for your finance team with payment terms, I can do that post-call.

See you Friday 9:30am PT — calendar invite sent.

Best regards,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
